execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."api_keys" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "key_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "key_prefix" text NOT NULL,
  "last_used_at" timestamptz,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "org_id" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."browsers" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "persona_id" text NOT NULL,
  "task" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."collect_links" (
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "credential_id" text NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("code")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."connections" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "enabled" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "persona_id" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "url" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."credentials" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "fields" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "persona_id" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."files" (
  "content_type" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "persona_id" text NOT NULL,
  "session_id" text,
  "size" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."instructions" (
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "enabled" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "persona_id" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."link_codes" (
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "persona_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("code")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."links" (
  "channel" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "external_id" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "label" text,
  "last_message_at" timestamptz,
  "line" text NOT NULL,
  "persona_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "links_channel_check_d774a31d" CHECK ("channel" IN ('whatsapp', 'telegram'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."notes" (
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "persona_id" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."organizations" (
  "clerk_created_at" timestamptz,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "image_url" text,
  "invitations" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "members" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "members_count" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "org_id" text NOT NULL,
  "slug" text,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."personas" (
  "composio_session_id" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "image_url" text,
  "model" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "org_id" text NOT NULL,
  "parent_id" text,
  "project_id" text NOT NULL,
  "snapshot_id" text,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."projects" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "image_url" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "org_id" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."report_requests" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "link_id" text NOT NULL,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "persona_id" text NOT NULL,
  "sent_at" timestamptz,
  "source" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."schedule_runs" (
  "claimed_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "ended_at" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "result" jsonb,
  "schedule_id" text NOT NULL,
  "scheduled_for" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "session_id" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'running' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "schedule_runs_status_check_77fab0ab" CHECK ("status" IN ('running', 'completed', 'failed'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."schedules" (
  "at" timestamptz,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "cron" text,
  "enabled" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "link_id" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "next_run_at" timestamptz,
  "persona_id" text NOT NULL,
  "prompt" text NOT NULL,
  "timezone" text DEFAULT 'UTC' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."secrets" (
  "owner_id" text NOT NULL,
  "values" jsonb NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("owner_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sessions" (
  "channel" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "persona_id" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."skills" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "enabled" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "files" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "markdown" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "origin" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "persona_id" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."snapshots" (
  "contents" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
  "persona_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."telegram_bots" (
  "bot_id" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "project_id" text NOT NULL,
  "username" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "auth_id" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "first_name" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "image_url" text,
  "last_name" text,
  "organization_ids" text[] NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "users_organization_ids_elem_not_null_2a985324" CHECK (array_position("organization_ids", NULL) IS NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."webhook_runs" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "ended_at" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "result" jsonb,
  "session_id" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'running' NOT NULL,
  "webhook_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "webhook_runs_status_check_77fab0ab" CHECK ("status" IN ('running', 'completed', 'failed'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."webhooks" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "enabled" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "link_id" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "persona_id" text NOT NULL,
  "prompt" text NOT NULL,
  "secret" text DEFAULT ((gen_random_uuid())::text) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."whatsapp_lines" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "number" text NOT NULL,
  "phone_number_id" text NOT NULL,
  "project_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
